title: FeaturePromise
description: Bound artifact for /deliver invocations. Composed during kickoff via exhaustive plan-anchored search. Tier-3 stewardship verdicts judge the rendered screenshot against this promise.

name.description: Slug-case identifier; used in shift id.

handle.description: The argument passed to /deliver — plan name, manifesto reference, or natural-language gap description.

vision_quotes.description: Verbatim quotes from manifesto/epic narrative anchoring the WHY of the feature.

plan_deliverables.description: Verbatim list from the plan(s) of what was supposed to land.

deliverable.description: Verbatim deliverable text from the plan.

user_visible.description: True if this deliverable should produce something the user can see in the app. Tier-3 judgment focuses on user_visible deliverables.

manifesto_anchors.description: Optional. Additional manifesto/epic references that ground the deliverables.

scenarios_existing.description: Gherkin scenarios already authored that assert this delivery. Format: 'features/path/file.feature: scenario name'.

scenarios_missing.description: Gaps where scenarios should exist but don't. Drives /generate-scenarios dispatches during the iteration loop.

intent.description: What this scenario should assert about the delivered experience.

screenshot_targets.description: Per-scenario expected visual proof. Tier-3 judges the rendered screenshot against what_should_be_visible.

scenario_name.description: Optional. Name of the specific scenario the screenshot proves.

what_should_be_visible.description: Structural description of what the screenshot must show for tier-3 to verdict 'delivered'. NO transcribed text — describe structure (e.g. 'topology graph rendered with peer nodes; legend visible; loading state cleared'), not exact strings ('says "3 peers connected"').

philosophy.const: unbounded; agent commits to whatever delivers
philosophy.description: Hard-coded constant. /deliver does not negotiate scope at kickoff like /shift does — scope is unbounded by design.

consent_required_paths.description: Globs requiring explicit user consent before edit. Destructive/irreversible paths still need user OK. Defaults: production configs, .github/workflows/, DNA-notarized validators when changing the LAW, crypto/identity files.

iterations.description: Soft signal. /deliver does not bail on iteration count alone — only on design-uncharted or consent-required.

search_calls.description: Soft cap on grep/read calls in any single search-first phase. After this, agent must propose action with what it has.

search_trail.description: Audit log of every search location visited during kickoff and any mid-iteration ambiguity-resolution searches. Bail-with-proposal requires this to have ≥7 unique entries with non-empty result fields.

location.description: Path, glob, or grep pattern searched.

iteration.description: Iteration number when this search was performed; null for kickoff searches.

notes.description: Optional. Brief observation about what was found at this location.
